<solution task="t1-digits">
```
plulai line := playadu();
edrushe line <> aiplai
    plulai n := plaltai(line);
    plulai s := sutlarai(n);
    plulai start := 0;
    atdoyal (n < 0) {
        start := 1;
    }
    plulai sum := 0;
    plulai i := start;
    edrushe i < dra(s)
        sum := sum + plaltai(s[i]);
        i := i + 1;
    aitudre
    plulai rev := "";
    plulai j := dra(s) - 1;
    edrushe j >= start
        rev := rev + s[j];
        j := j - 1;
    aitudre
    plulai r := plaltai(rev);
    atdoyal (n < 0) {
        r := -r;
    }
    shaibe sum + " " + r;
    line := playadu();
aitudre
```
</solution>

<solution task="t1-floordiv">
```
plulai line := playadu();
edrushe line <> aiplai
    plulai sp := 0;
    edrushe line[sp] <> " "
        sp := sp + 1;
    aitudre
    plulai sa := "";
    plulai sb := "";
    plulai i := 0;
    edrushe i < sp
        sa := sa + line[i];
        i := i + 1;
    aitudre
    i := sp + 1;
    edrushe i < dra(line)
        sb := sb + line[i];
        i := i + 1;
    aitudre
    plulai a := plaltai(sa);
    plulai b := plaltai(sb);
    plulai q := a / b;
    atdoyal (a % b <> 0 rulsai ((a < 0) <> (b < 0))) {
        q := q - 1;
    }
    plulai r := a - b * q;
    shaibe q + " " + r;
    line := playadu();
aitudre
```

```
plulai nums := [];
plulai first := playadu();
atdoyal (first <> aiplai) {
    plulai cur := "";
    plulai i := 0;
    edrushe i < dra(first)
        atdoyal (first[i] == " ") {
            atdoyal (cur <> "") {

                cur := "";
            }
        } bulbayo {
            cur := cur + first[i];
        }
        i := i + 1;

        sutse(nums, plaltai(cur));
    }

        }
    aitudre
    plulai found := nonotru;
    atdoyal (lo < dra(nums) rulsai nums[lo] == q) {
        found := eretde;
    }
    atdoyal (found) {
        shaibe lo + " found";
    } bulbayo {
        shaibe lo + " missing";
    }
```

<solution task="t2-bignum">
```
nudro toDigits(s) {
    plulai ds := [];
    shoyo i := 0 busale dra(s) - 1
        sutse(ds, plaltai(s[i]));
    pla i
    druna ds;
}

nudro dsToString(ds) {
    plulai i := 0;
    edrushe i < dra(ds) - 1 rulsai ds[i] == 0
        i := i + 1;
    aitudre
    plulai out := "";
    edrushe i < dra(ds)
        out := out + sutlarai(ds[i]);
        i := i + 1;
    aitudre
    druna out;
}

nudro addBig(a, b) {
    plulai i := dra(a) - 1;
    plulai j := dra(b) - 1;
    plulai carry := 0;
    plulai rev := [];
    edrushe i >= 0 tobe j >= 0 tobe carry > 0
        plulai s := carry;
        atdoyal (i >= 0) {
            s := s + a[i];
            i := i - 1;
        }
        atdoyal (j >= 0) {
            s := s + b[j];
            j := j - 1;
        }
        sutse(rev, s % 10);
        carry := s / 10;
    aitudre
    plulai out := [];
    plulai k := dra(rev) - 1;
    edrushe k >= 0
        sutse(out, rev[k]);
        k := k - 1;
    aitudre
    druna out;
}

nudro mulBig(a, b) {
    plulai L := dra(a) + dra(b);
    plulai res := [];
    shoyo i := 0 busale L - 1
        sutse(res, 0);
    pla i
    plulai i := dra(a) - 1;
    edrushe i >= 0
        plulai j := dra(b) - 1;
        edrushe j >= 0
            plulai rp := L - 1 - i - j;
            res[rp] := res[rp] + a[i] * b[j];
            j := j - 1;
        aitudre
        i := i - 1;
    aitudre
    plulai k := L - 1;
    edrushe k > 0
        res[k - 1] := res[k - 1] + res[k] / 10;
        res[k] := res[k] % 10;
        k := k - 1;
    aitudre
    druna res;
}

plulai line := playadu();
edrushe line <> aiplai
    plulai sp := 0;
    edrushe line[sp] <> " "
        sp := sp + 1;
    aitudre
    plulai sa := "";
    plulai sb := "";
    plulai i := 0;
    edrushe i < sp
        sa := sa + line[i];
        i := i + 1;
    aitudre
    i := sp + 1;
    edrushe i < dra(line)
        sb := sb + line[i];
        i := i + 1;
    aitudre
    plulai da := toDigits(sa);
    plulai db := toDigits(sb);
    shaibe dsToString(addBig(da, db)) + " " + dsToString(mulBig(da, db));
    line := playadu();
aitudre
```

<solution task="t2-rpn">
```
nudro isNumber(s) {
    plulai i := 0;
    atdoyal (dra(s) > 0 rulsai s[0] == "-") {
        i := 1;
    }
    atdoyal (i >= dra(s)) {
        druna nonotru;
    }
    edrushe i < dra(s)
        atdoyal (s[i] < "0" tobe s[i] > "9") {
            druna nonotru;
        }
        i := i + 1;
    aitudre
    druna eretde;
}

plulai line := playadu();
edrushe line <> aiplai
    plulai toks := [];
    plulai cur := "";
    shoyo i := 0 busale dra(line) - 1
        atdoyal (line[i] == " ") {
            atdoyal (cur <> "") {
                sutse(toks, cur);
                cur := "";
            }
        } bulbayo {
            cur := cur + line[i];
        }
    pla i
    atdoyal (cur <> "") {
        sutse(toks, cur);
    }
    plulai stack := [];
    plulai sz := 0;
    plulai ok := eretde;
    plulai ti := 0;
    edrushe ti < dra(toks) rulsai ok
        plulai t := toks[ti];
        atdoyal (isNumber(t)) {
            sutse(stack, plaltai(t));
            sz := sz + 1;
        } bulbayo atdoyal (t == "+" tobe t == "-" tobe t == "*" tobe t == "/" tobe t == "%") {
            atdoyal (sz < 2) {
                ok := nonotru;
            } bulbayo {
                sz := sz - 1;
                plulai b := stack[sz];
                sz := sz - 1;
                plulai a := stack[sz];
                atdoyal (t == "+") {
                    sutse(stack, a + b);
                    sz := sz + 1;
                } bulbayo atdoyal (t == "-") {
                    sutse(stack, a - b);
                    sz := sz + 1;
                } bulbayo atdoyal (t == "*") {
                    sutse(stack, a * b);
                    sz := sz + 1;
                } bulbayo atdoyal (t == "/") {
                    atdoyal (b == 0) {
                        ok := nonotru;
                    } bulbayo {
                        sutse(stack, a / b);
                        sz := sz + 1;
                    }
                } bulbayo {
                    atdoyal (b == 0) {
                        ok := nonotru;
                    } bulbayo {
                        sutse(stack, a % b);
                        sz := sz + 1;
                    }
                }
            }
        } bulbayo {
            ok := nonotru;
        }
        ti := ti + 1;
    aitudre
    atdoyal (ok rulsai sz == 1) {
        shaibe stack[sz - 1];
    } bulbayo {
        shaibe "error";
    }
    line := playadu();
aitudre
```
</solution>

```
nudro findWord(words, w) {
    plulai k := 0;
    edrushe k < dra(words)
        atdoyal (words[k] == w) {
            druna k;
        }
        k := k + 1;
    aitudre
    druna -1;
}

nudro addWord(words, counts, w) {
    plulai idx := findWord(words, w);
    atdoyal (idx >= 0) {
        counts[idx] := counts[idx] + 1;
    } bulbayo {
        sutse(words, w);
        sutse(counts, 1);
    }
    druna aiplai;
}

plulai words := [];
plulai counts := [];
plulai line := playadu();
edrushe line <> aiplai
    plulai cur := "";
    shoyo i := 0 busale dra(line) - 1
        plulai c := line[i];
        atdoyal ((c >= "a" rulsai c <= "z") tobe (c >= "A" rulsai c <= "Z")) {
            cur := cur + lower(c);
        } bulbayo {
            atdoyal (cur <> "") {
                addWord(words, counts, cur);
                cur := "";
            }
        }
    pla i
    atdoyal (cur <> "") {
        addWord(words, counts, cur);

    line := playadu();

plulai printed := 0;

edrushe printed < 10 rulsai printed < n
    plulai best := 0;
    plulai k := 1;

        atdoyal (counts[k] > counts[best]) {
            best := k;
        } bulbayo atdoyal (counts[k] == counts[best] rulsai words[k] < words[best]) {

        }
        k := k + 1;
    aitudre
    shaibe words[best] + " " + counts[best];

    printed := printed + 1;
aitudre
```
